aboutDescription: HisabMitra keeps your daily hisab, personal khata and family group expenses in your account, with a copy on your phone so it works without internet.
updateNotConfigured: Update checks are not set up in this build.
updateInstallSteps: The file was verified (checksum, package and signature). Android will now ask you to confirm the installation. Your hisab stays safe in your account and on this phone.
updateAllowInstall: Allow HisabMitra to install updates in the next screen, then tap Download & install again.
updateNoChecksum: This release has no published checksum, so it cannot be installed from inside the app. Open the release page instead.
updateChecksumMismatch: The downloaded file did not match its published checksum and was deleted.
updateWrongPackage: The downloaded file is not a HisabMitra update.
updateNotNewer: The downloaded version is not newer than the installed one.
updateSignatureMismatch: The update is not signed with the same key as this app, so Android would refuse it. Install it manually from the release page only if you trust the source.
updateUnreadable: The downloaded file could not be read.
shareAppText:
📒 *HisabMitra — Smart Hisab, Happy Family*

I keep my family's hisab in HisabMitra:
✅ Daily income and expenses
🤝 Money given and taken (khata)
👨‍👩‍👧 Family and trip expense splitting
📊 Reports in English and ગુજરાતી
privacySummary: Your personal records, people, khata, reminders and bills are saved to your HisabMitra account, and only you can see them. Group expenses are shared with that group's members. Your phone keeps a copy so the app works offline; signing out removes it. Optional online AI receives summary figures only after your consent. No advertising or tracking SDKs are included.
termsSummary: HisabMitra is a record-keeping tool. Please check important figures yourself; it does not provide financial, tax or legal advice.
